## What's new

**Compress a selection.** Select one or more items and choose **Compress…** from
the context menu or the File menu. A small sheet lets you pick the format —
**ZIP** or **TAR** — the compression — **none, gzip, bzip2 or xz** — and an
editable name, with the matching extension (`.zip`, `.tar`, `.tar.gz`,
`.tar.bz2`, `.tar.xz`) shown as you go. ZIP keeps resource forks and folder
names; the archive lands in the current folder and is selected when it is done.
A name clash asks the same **Replace / Keep Both / Skip** question as copy and
paste, long runs get the progress window with Cancel, and a failure says why.

**The path bar flashes red again.** Typing a path that does not exist — and
pressing Return or Tab — pulses the field red and leaves the broken part marked,
while the good part stays put. The flash had gone missing; it is back.

## Installing

Download `RoachExplorer-v0.1.6.zip`, unzip it, and drag **Roach Explorer** into
Applications. The app is ad-hoc signed, so the first launch may need
right-click → Open. Verify the download with the SHA-256 file next to it:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c RoachExplorer-v0.1.6.zip.sha256
```

Requires macOS 14 or later.
